Testimonial Card Generator

Create a styled testimonial card — quote, author, star rating — with live preview and copy-ready HTML/CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Type the quote, author name and role/company.
  2. Set the star rating and pick an accent color and card style.
  3. Preview the card live.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained testimonial.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the avatar initials made?

Automatically from the author name — the first letters of the first two words.

Can I use half stars?

The generator uses full stars from 1–5 for clean, copy-ready markup.

Is it responsive?

Yes — the card is fluid and caps at a readable max width.

Can I embed it in an existing page?

Copy the markup and the <style> block; all classes are prefixed with tm- to avoid collisions.
